task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move BOX_MIDDLE to INSPECTION_TABLE while maintaining the stack constraint (only top box can be picked). First pick BOX_TOP and temporarily place it on TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, then retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM so the final stack has only BOX_BOTTOM with BOX_TOP on top.
assumptions: Only the top box of the stack can be picked at any time (stack/LIFO constraint)
TEMP_TABLE is available as a temporary holding location for BOX_TOP
BOX_TOP can be placed back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack minus the middle layer
After removing BOX_TOP, BOX_MIDDLE becomes the new top and can be picked
